items.title: Migrate F5 BIG-IP load balancers to AWS with AWS Transform
items.summary: Introduction Load balancers are often the last piece of a migration that teams want to think about and the first piece that breaks when traffic moves. A single load balancer can front dozens or hundreds of virtual servers, each with its own pools, monitors, persistence profiles, and TLS settings. Rebuilding each one by hand as […]
